title: Support standalone runners and complete app-folder reviews
summary: AL review skills now support standalone runners and folder-based app reviews by decoupling scheduling concerns and enabling parallel execution of independent review domains while maintaining deterministic result ordering.
key_points: Scheduling becomes an orchestrator responsibility, allowing isolated review leaves to run serially or concurrently
Folder-path is defined as a complete review scope across standalone adapter and all AL review leaves
Severity counts now calculate from deduplicated findings instead of summing leaf results
Documentation reorganized with standalone-runner guide, walk-up app review flow, and conceptual architecture moved to docs/
Sub-results ordering remains deterministic regardless of completion order
quote: Define scheduling as an orchestrator-owned concern and allow isolated leaves to run serially or concurrently.
